description: Generating fake Goods & Services Tax (GST) invoices from a nonexistent paper warehouse to claim ₹1.8 crore in input tax credits without delivering any goods.
explanation: ILLEGAL EVASION. Fabricating bogus invoices for goods that were never manufactured or supplied is outright criminal tax fraud and forgery.

description: Registering software intellectual property in a zero-tax overseas jurisdiction and charging its Nagarpur operating branch 90% royalties to wipe out local taxable profits.
explanation: LEGAL AVOIDANCE (Aggressive Base Erosion). Exploits international transfer pricing and double tax treaty rules. Technically legal under current statutes, though it drains domestic revenue.

description: Offering a 20% discount to all patients who pay in cash, and maintaining an unrecorded spiral notebook behind the counter instead of entering sales into the billing software.
explanation: ILLEGAL EVASION. Maintaining two sets of accounting books (kaccha khata) and deliberately suppressing gross sales is criminal tax fraud.

description: Accelerating depreciation claims on new green energy rooftop equipment in the very first fiscal year, as permitted under the National Renewable Energy Incentive Act.
explanation: LEGAL PLANNING / AVOIDANCE. Utilizing explicit statutory exemptions provided by lawmakers to promote renewable energy adoption.

description: Requiring wedding bookings to pay 60% of the hall rent via bearer cash envelopes, declaring only the remaining 40% catering fee on official tax filings.
explanation: ILLEGAL EVASION. Deliberate non-declaration of cash revenues to evade local municipal luxury and commercial tax.

description: Setting up 18 distinct subsidiary companies each holding one parcel of land, ensuring each entity stays below the mandatory municipal land ceiling threshold.
explanation: LEGAL AVOIDANCE. Structuring corporate entity boundaries to circumvent tax and land regulatory caps while observing statutory wording.

description: Smuggling 15 kilograms of unrefined gold bullion inside customized truck spare tire compartments to avoid paying import customs duties.
explanation: ILLEGAL EVASION. Contraband smuggling and physical concealment of dutiable commodities is a serious criminal offense.

description: Routing all regional medicine shipments through a neighboring state with a 0.5% lower interstate tax rate by registering a nominal post-box office there.
explanation: LEGAL AVOIDANCE (Forum Shopping). Capitalizing on jurisdictional interstate tax rate differentials through strategic address registration.

description: Paying foreign star coaches in off-the-record cryptocurrency sent to untracked private wallets, with zero withholding tax deducted at source.
explanation: ILLEGAL EVASION. Evading mandatory Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on payroll obligations through untracked digital assets.

description: Donating surplus profits to a recognized agricultural research trust to claim a 100% tax deduction under statutory charitable deduction provisions.
explanation: LEGAL AVOIDANCE / INCENTIVE. Utilizing clear legal provisions intended by parliament to stimulate philanthropic and research funding.

description: Deleting electronic cash register point-of-sale audit logs at midnight using automated zapper software to underreport monthly turnover by 35%.
explanation: ILLEGAL EVASION. Using automated sales suppression software (zappers) to falsify electronic audit trails is high-tech fraud.

description: Issuing convertible preference shares to a friendly offshore trust in Mauritius right before declaring a massive dividend to bypass domestic distribution taxes.
explanation: LEGAL AVOIDANCE (Treaty Shopping). Sophisticated legal structuring to exploit bilateral tax treaty loopholes.

description: Selling pre-owned luxury sedans for ₹45 lakh each while recording the sale agreement at ₹12 lakh and accepting ₹33 lakh in physical cash bundles.
explanation: ILLEGAL EVASION (Undervaluation). Under-reporting property and asset sale considerations to depress stamp duty and capital gains taxes.

description: Paying executive bonuses as 'reimbursement of entertainment allowances' supported by blank restaurant receipts purchased from stationery shops.
explanation: ILLEGAL EVASION. Forging fictitious expense documentation to mask taxable executive compensation.

description: Timing the acquisition of heavy spinning looms to March 29th specifically to claim full-year capital allowances for that financial year.
explanation: LEGAL AVOIDANCE (Tax Timing). Arranging the timing of legitimate commercial asset acquisitions within the statutory financial calendar.

description: Claiming corporate headquarters utility bills as deductible expenses for an under-construction public toll road project in another district.
explanation: ILLEGAL EVASION. Falsely misallocating corporate overheads to inflate capital deductions on public infrastructure concessions.

description: Structuring movie ticket pricing by separating ₹100 admission from ₹150 mandatory 'air-conditioning convenience charge' to reduce entertainment tax liability.
explanation: LEGAL AVOIDANCE. Unbundling service charges to exploit specific definitions in local municipal entertainment tax bylaws.

description: Maintaining an iron safe containing ₹12 crore in unregistered diamond jewellery without any purchase vouchers or declaration in wealth tax filings.
explanation: ILLEGAL EVASION. Concealing high-value physical assets and unexplained wealth outside official books of account.
